"### AUH Benefits Chart Description

This line chart tracks the value of AUH (Universal Child Allowance) benefits in Argentina over time, adjusted for inflation to constant December 2023 prices.

**Chart Specifications:**

*   **Title:** AUH Benefits
*   **Unit of Measure:** Thousands of AR$ (Argentine Pesos), constant December 2023 prices.
*   **Vertical Axis (Y):** Represents the value in thousands, ranging from 15 to 50 in increments of 5.
*   **Horizontal Axis (X):** Represents time from January 2018 to April 2024.

**Data Observations:**

The chart shows a general downward trend with significant monthly fluctuations (a "sawtooth" pattern) from 2018 through late 2023. The value reached its lowest point in late 2023 before experiencing a sharp, dramatic spike in early 2024.

| X-Axis Label (Date) | Approximate Y-Value (Thousands of AR$) |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Jan-18** | ~40 |
| **Jun-18** | ~38 |
| **Nov-18** | ~33 |
| **Apr-19** | ~35 |
| **Sep-19** | ~40 |
| **Feb-20** | ~34 |
| **Jul-20** | ~37 |
| **Dec-20** | ~34 |
| **May-21** | ~31 |
| **Oct-21** | ~34 |
| **Mar-22** | ~32 |
| **Aug-22** | ~31 |
| **Jan-23** | ~31 |
| **Jun-23** | ~29 |
| **Nov-23** | ~17 (Lowest point on chart) |
| **Apr-24** | ~41 (Sharp recovery) |

**Summary Trend:**
The benefits started at approximately 40,000 AR$ in January 2018 and gradually eroded to below 20,000 AR$ by November 2023. Between November 2023 and April 2024, the value spiked rapidly, returning to a level slightly above 40,000 AR$."
